error_taxonomy.mitigation: Extend classifier rules or model prompt with the missed signal; add a dev case.
Inspect stage ordering and upstream evidence; add cascade cases of this shape.
Capture longer or more targeted log excerpts at collection time.
Revise the bounded context policy (new version; never edit in place).
Check pipeline graph completeness; add missing depends_on edges.
Reject outputs that reference files or symbols absent from the repository.
Require the exact failing test to be rerun after the patch.
Run the full regression suite before acceptance.
Strengthen verification-integrity rules for this fake-fix shape.
Review the policy rule; a correct repair was blocked.
Add a policy or integrity rule; an incorrect repair was not blocked.
Add an independent oracle (behavioural invariant or hidden test) for this behaviour.
Pin the environment or mark the case environment-dependent.
Rerun to confirm; quarantine evidence rather than repairing code.
